# Virus-tracker

> Daily AI-ready pathogen and outbreak intelligence. Generated 2026-10-26T08:12:53.373083Z. 848 records.

## Files
- [events.jsonl](events.jsonl): one JSON event per line, schema `virus-tracker.event.v1`
- [events.json](events.json): JSON array of events
- [events.csv](events.csv): flattened tabular export
- [event.schema.json](event.schema.json): JSON Schema for a single event
- [manifest.json](manifest.json): dataset manifest, counts, sources, checksums
- [dataset-card.md](dataset-card.md): dataset card and field descriptions
- [digest.md](digest.md): Chinese daily briefing
- [history-100d.md](history-100d.md): 100-day retrospective report
- [history-100d.json](history-100d.json): 100-day structured statistics
- [history-all.md](history-all.md): full retrospective from VT_DATA_START_DATE
- [history-all.json](history-all.json): full structured statistics
- [graph.json](graph.json): event–pathogen–host–location knowledge graph

## Quick start
Use `embedding_text` for retrieval. Use `pathogens[].name`, `hosts`, `locations`, `severity.label`
and `severity.score` for filtering. Always keep `source.url` and `provenance.content_hash`
for traceability.

## Scope
Human, animal, poultry, livestock and wildlife pathogens (viruses, bacteria, fungi, parasites,
prions) reported by PubMed, WHO, CDC, WOAH, UKHSA, CIDRAP and other public sources.

## Disclaimer
Machine-generated; verify against the original source before clinical, veterinary or policy use.
